import workcell, re, statistics, sys

def log(msg):
    print(msg, flush=True)

def cmd(*args):
    r = workcell.call(*args)
    log(f"> {' '.join(args)} :: {r.ok} :: {r.text}")
    return r

def parse_tcp(text):
    m = re.search(r'TCP \(encoders\) x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+) z=([-\d.]+).*Fz=([-\d.+]+)', text)
    if not m:
        return None
    return tuple(map(float, m.groups()))

def vision():
    r = workcell.call("vision", "locate")
    text = r.text
    cap = re.search(r'cap: centre x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+) z=([-\d.]+)', text)
    peg = re.search(r'peg: centre x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+) z=([-\d.]+) mm; lower end x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+) z=([-\d.]+) mm; tilt ([-\d.]+)', text)
    hole = re.search(r'socket hole centre: x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+) mm, top at z=([-\d.]+)', text)
    return {
        "text": text,
        "cap": tuple(map(float, cap.groups())) if cap else None,
        "peg": tuple(map(float, peg.groups())) if peg else None,
        "hole": tuple(map(float, hole.groups())) if hole else (0.0, 60.0, 55.0),
    }

def avg_peg(n=4):
    ss = []
    hole = None
    for _ in range(n):
        v = vision()
        hole = v["hole"]
        if v["peg"]:
            ss.append(v["peg"])
    if not ss:
        return None, hole
    mean = tuple(statistics.mean(c) for c in zip(*ss))
    return mean, hole

# --- cap removal ---
r = cmd("robot", "pick", "cap", "--arm", "left")
if not r.ok:

r = cmd("robot", "place", "bin", "--arm", "left")
if not r.ok:
    sys.exit(3)

# --- pick peg ---
r = cmd("robot", "pick", "peg", "--arm", "right")
if not r.ok:
    sys.exit(4)

# lift clear
r = cmd("robot", "move", "right", "150", "140", "230")
tcp = parse_tcp(r.text)

# go above socket, approximate offset compensation (true ~= encoder + (8, 3))
# want true TCP such that we'll refine with vision. Just hover high over hole.
r = cmd("robot", "move", "right", "-8", "57", "220")
tcp = parse_tcp(r.text)

peg, hole = avg_peg(3)
log(f"hover peg {peg} hole {hole}")
if peg is None:
    # lower a bit so jig can see the peg
    r = cmd("robot", "move", "right", "-8", "57", "180")
    peg, hole = avg_peg(3)
    log(f"lower hover peg {peg}")

hx, hy, hz = hole
# align lower end to hole xy
for i in range(5):
    peg, hole = avg_peg(3)
    if peg is None:
        log("no peg vision")
        break
    lx, ly, lz = peg[3], peg[4], peg[5]
    ex, ey = hx - lx, hy - ly
    log(f"align {i}: lower ({lx:.2f},{ly:.2f},{lz:.2f}) err ({ex:.2f},{ey:.2f}) tilt {peg[6]:.2f}")
    if abs(ex) < 0.45 and abs(ey) < 0.45:
        break
    dx = max(-15, min(15, ex))
    dy = max(-15, min(15, ey))
    r = cmd("robot", "step", "right", f"{dx:.2f}", f"{dy:.2f}", "0")
    tcp = parse_tcp(r.text)

# descend so tip is ~12mm above socket top
peg, hole = avg_peg(2)
lx, ly, lz = peg[3], peg[4], peg[5]
target_tip = hz + 12  # 67
drop = lz - target_tip
log(f"coarse drop {drop:.1f} mm tip {lz:.1f} -> {target_tip:.1f}")
while drop > 1.5:

    r = cmd("robot", "step", "right", "0", "0", f"{dz:.2f}")

    if tcp and abs(tcp[3]) > 10:

for i in range(4):
    peg, hole = avg_peg(3)
    lx, ly, lz = peg[3], peg[4], peg[5]
    ex, ey = hx - lx, hy - ly
    log(f"near align {i}: lower ({lx:.2f},{ly:.2f},{lz:.2f}) err ({ex:.2f},{ey:.2f})")
    if abs(ex) < 0.4 and abs(ey) < 0.4:
        break
    r = cmd("robot", "step", "right", f"{max(-12,min(12,ex)):.2f}", f"{max(-12,min(12,ey)):.2f}", "0")

# insert
seated = False
rim_hits = 0
spiral = [(0,0),(1.2,0),(-1.2,0),(0,1.2),(0,-1.2),(1.2,1.2),(-1.2,1.2),(1.2,-1.2),(-1.2,-1.2),(2.2,0),(0,2.2),(-2.2,0),(0,-2.2)]

base_tcp = None

for cycle in range(6):

    stalled_high = False
    for k in range(15):
        peg, hole = avg_peg(1)
        tipz = peg[5] if peg else 999
        dz = -8 if tipz > 40 else -3
        r = cmd("robot", "step", "right", "0", "0", f"{dz:.2f}")
        tcp = parse_tcp(r.text)
        if tcp is None:
            log("step failed")
            stalled_high = True
            break
        moved = True
        # detect stall: force and little motion. We don't have previous z easily; use force magnitude and tip z
        fz = tcp[3]
        log(f"  push tipz~{tipz:.1f} tcpz={tcp[2]:.1f} Fz={fz:.1f}")

                else:

        if peg and peg[5] < 16:

            break

    if stalled_high or not seated:
        rim_hits += 1
        spiral_i += 1
        if spiral_i >= len(spiral):
            log("spiral exhausted")
            break
        ox, oy = spiral[spiral_i]
        log(f"rim recovery {rim_hits} offset {ox},{oy}")
        # lift
        cmd("robot", "step", "right", "0", "0", "15")

        peg, hole = avg_peg(3)
        if peg:

            cmd("robot", "step", "right", f"{max(-15,min(15,ex)):.2f}", f"{max(-15,min(15,ey)):.2f}", "0")

r = cmd("robot", "move", "right", "40", "20", "250")

log(cmd("robot", "scene").text)
log(cmd("trial", "status").text)
